title.value: AB-2515 Menstrual products: perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)

pfas_definition.value: a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom
pfas_definition.provenance: 25258. d) PFAS means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: 25258.4. (a) A manufacturer of a menstrual product shall not manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state a menstrual product that contains regulated PFAS.

intentionally_added.provenance: 25258. d) PFAS means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.
